gameName: Roll Camera!: The Filmmaking Board Game
editionLabel: English Keen Bean Studio rules, thirteen-sheet publisher-linked PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently filmed a movie starts. Alternatively, choose the starting player at random.
officialTieBreak: The rulebook expressly permits random selection as an alternative.
clarifications: This is a cooperative game. The first player receives the six Crew dice and the Budget/Schedule dials.
